target_contract: A parent native host withholds a downstream artifact worker unless every required capability-bound receipt passes, and launches that worker only after the passing receipts have joined.

required_assertions: both wave-one workers are spawned, joined, and closed
the lifecycle gate evaluates to block
the closeout Dispatch Spec validator returns block
both wave-one workers are spawned, joined, and closed
the lifecycle gate evaluates to pass
the artifact-repair worker is spawned only after the gate-pass event
the artifact worker consumes both passing receipts and writes its bounded output
all workers are joined and closed
the closeout Dispatch Spec validator returns pass

overall_verdict.KEEP: every assertion in both scenarios passes in the required order
overall_verdict.FIX: one or more assertions fail, an unauthorized write occurs, or the success artifact worker starts before its gate

non_claims: This canary does not prove correctness of arbitrary host runtimes.
This canary does not promote lifecycle or Dispatch Spec authority.
This canary proves only the observed native host execution represented by this run folder.
